text:
maya: quick UX review of modal header — close button feels cramped on mobile, and the primary action overlaps the title when window is narrow.

ryan: noted. current close icon visual is 16px with 6px padding. we should keep visual but expand hit area to 44px.

tess: +1 for hit area. also suggest using a consistent focus ring token (--focus-ring) and avoid changing icon fill on focus, use outline only.

maya: also the modal title truncates too early. can we reduce right-side action spacing to a token (--modal-action-gap: 10px) and move tertiary actions into a kebab at <420px?

ryan: sounds reasonable. will prototype kebab fallback and post screenshot.

design-bot: TODO created: COMPONENTS-320 "modal: increase close hit target, add focus token, action-gap token, kebab fallback"; target milestone 2.15.0.
